Comoros
Consular help: Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Canberra, Australia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens (Visa shell be issued in Paris):
Regular passport YES
Service/Official passport YES
Diplomatic passport YES
Citizens of the Republic of Comoros are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visa shall be issued in Canberra, Australia.
